topic: A homeowner discovers previous residents left items in the attic
text: Hey, I can't believe what you found up there, honestly. All those boxes, like echoes of a life once lived in your very own space. It's a bit strange, you know? To uncover someone else’s past in your new beginning. I can’t help but wonder about the stories behind each item, the memories that might be dusted off with every touch. It's a heavy kind of discovery, sorting through it all. I get why you're taking your time, why it's not just another moving task. If you ever want to talk about it, or about anything really, I’m here. Just call.
